answer.text: For agencies, the most commonly recommended project management tools are ClickUp, Asana, and Monday.com. ClickUp suits agencies that want docs, time tracking, and client views in one place. Asana is strong for cross-team workflows and approvals. Monday.com is popular for its visual boards and client-facing dashboards. Teamwork and Notion are also options for smaller agencies that bill by the hour or need a lightweight wiki.
